body.message:
Apologies for the delay.

For the self-check-in process, we will require the following details:

Copy of your passport
Email address

Once we receive the required details, we will share the payment link for the refundable security deposit. Upon receipt of the security deposit payment, we will be able to block the unit for you.

Please note that if you wish to secure the unit for the entire booking period, the first month’s rent, last month’s rent, and refundable security deposit must be paid in advance.

Once these payments are received, we will be able to reserve the unit and secure the agreed booking period.
